operating_notes.text: Total coal production for FY26 stood at 768.19 MT.
April 2026 coal production stood at 56.1 Million Tonnes, down 9.7% YoY.
April 2026 SWMA e-auction: 305.51 lakh tonnes offered, 117.74 lakh tonnes allocated (39%), at a 51% increase over notified price.
Commissioned a 100 MW solar power plant in Banaskantha, Gujarat, effective March 31, 2026.
Wholly owned subsidiary CIL Solar PV Limited was struck off and dissolved under Section 248(2) of the Companies Act, 2013.
Alternative Mechanism approved listing and up to 25% disinvestment of Mahanadi Coalfields Limited.
26 May 2026: CIL mine-head coal inventory 113.5 MT (24 May), up 10% YoY, sufficient for 19 days of consumption; system total 168 MT including 47.6 MT at domestic coal-based plants.
26 May 2026: around 50 MT of in-situ mine coal stated as ready for quicker extraction if demand necessitates.
26 May 2026: of 21 plants categorised critical as of 20 May, 11 are domestic coal-based and 7 of those source coal from CIL.
26 May 2026: Government OFS of up to 6,16,27,283 Coal India shares (1.00% base, 2.00% with oversubscription) at a floor price of ₹412; non-retail bidding 27 May, retail 29 May 2026.
May 2026: CIL offtake 66.7 MT exceeded production 56.1 MT by 10.6 MT, implying a draw on mine-head stock.
May 2026: NCL (9.5 MT, -23.7%) and MCL (14.3 MT, -20.1%) led the production decline; SECL (14.4 MT, +4.5%) was the largest producer.
May 2026: SWMA e-auction allocation was 84.20 lakh tonnes of 257.42 lakh tonnes offered (33%), at a 36% premium over notified price.
May 2026: MCL allocated 20.49 of 109.86 lakh tonnes offered (19%) and ECL 4.85 of 35.08 (14%); NCL and NEC were fully allocated.
Apr-May 2026: e-auction allocation was 201.94 lakh tonnes of 562.93 lakh tonnes offered (36%), at a 45% premium over notified price.
Coal India offered 35 million tonnes under linkage auction for non-regulated sector consumers to reduce import dependence.
H1FY27: Mine infrastructure development attracted ₹2,152 Cr, land acquisition ₹2,033 Cr, and diversification projects over ₹739 Cr.

timeline.summary: 2026-04-20: Coal India informed about proposed removal of subsidiary CIL Solar PV Ltd's name under Companies Act
2026-04-23: Coal India announced the reaffirmation of its long-term bank facilities at CARE AAA (Stable) and short-term facilities at CARE A1+ for a total of ₹14,230.38 Cr.
Coal India Limited’s Board of Directors, led by Executive Director (CS) Bijay Prakash Dubey, recommended a final dividend of ₹5.25 per equity share for FY 2025-26 on April 27, 2026.
Coal India reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹46,490 Cr and PAT of ₹10,908 Cr, bringing FY26 PAT to ₹31,071 Cr.
Coal India bagged a ₹400 Cr Letter of Award from Gridco for a 320 MWh BESS plant in Odisha.
Coal India reported April 2026 raw coal production of 56.1 Mill Te and offtake of 63.2 Mill Te.
Coal India released SWMA e-auction data for April 2026 showing 117.74 lakh tonnes allocated.
Coal India commissioned a 100 MW solar power plant in Banaskantha, Gujarat, effective March 31, 2026.
CIL Solar PV Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India, was struck off and dissolved under Section 248(2) of the Companies Act.
Coal India announced Alternative Mechanism approval for listing Mahanadi Coalfields Limited through up to a 25% disinvestment and fresh equity issue.
Coal India said on 26 May 2026 that 168 MT of coal was available in the system, including 113.5 MT at its mine heads (up 10% YoY), to meet summer demand.

On 26 May 2026 the Ministry of Coal announced an offer for sale of up to 6,16,27,283 Coal India shares (1.00% base, 2.00% with oversubscription) at a floor price of ₹412, with non-retail bidding on 27 May and retail on 29 May 2026.
Coal India received a ₹0.05 Cr fine from BSE on May 27, 2026, for non-compliance with board composition regulations.
Coal India reported provisional May 2026 coal production of 56.1 MT; and offtake of 66.7 MT

Coal India reported provisional May 2026 SWMA e-auction allocation of 84.20 lakh tonnes, 33% of 257.42 lakh tonnes offered, at a 36% premium over notified price; Apr-May 2026 allocation was 201.94 lakh tonnes at a 45% premium.
Coal India announced initiatives to offer a record 35 million tonnes of coal under linkage auctions for non-regulated sector consumers to curb high GCV coal imports.
Coal India reported H1FY27 capital expenditure of ₹7,966 crore, a 27% YoY increase, achieving 109% of its planned outlay for the period.
